summary: The person is handed a severance agreement in the same meeting where they learn the job is ending.
realLife: An HR article describes a worker told in a conference room that it was her last day and given a severance agreement at that meeting. The author advises explaining severance clearly.
sources: Workforce magazine, A humane approach to layoffs: https://workforce.com/news/a-humane-approach-to-layoffs
inGame: Job-ended event; severance agreement is not in the game, so it needs: severance and agreement records.
